title: Ergogen configuration schema
description: Describes the canonical Ergogen config, i.e., after dotted keys are unnested, "$extends" inheritance is resolved and "$params"/"$args" templates are applied (see "source/canonical.yaml" in the debug output).

engine.description: Minimum compatible Ergogen version (same major, equal or greater minor/patch)

version.description: Config version, written into the PCB title block

author.description: Config author, written into the PCB title block

units.description: Named values usable in any numeric field, evaluated in order and able to reference earlier ones

points.description: Defines the locations of the keys

zones.description: Named zones, each a grid of columns and rows

rotate.description: Global rotation applied to all points

mirror.description: Global mirroring for points not already mirrored by their zone

outlines.description: Named 2D outlines, each built from a list (or map) of parts

cases.description: Named 3D cases, each built from a list (or map) of extruded outlines or other cases

number.description: A number, or a math expression string that can reference units and variables

wh.description: A single number for both dimensions, or an [x, y] pair

asym.description: Which side of a mirrored pair to use (source, clone or both, plus their aliases)

units.description: Unit values, merged onto the defaults (null keeps the default)

anchor.description: A point reference name, a list of anchors applied cumulatively, or an anchor object

ref.description: Point to start from (cannot be combined with "aggregate")

aggregate.description: Combine multiple anchors into one starting point (cannot be combined with "ref")

method.description: "intersect" expects exactly two parts and uses their rotated y axes

orient.description: Rotation before shifting: an angle, or an anchor to turn towards

rotate.description: Rotation after shifting: an angle, or an anchor to turn towards

affect.description: Only keep these coordinates from the result, e.g., "xy" or [x, r]

resist.description: Do not invert shifts and rotations on mirrored points

mirror.description: Mirror axis: a literal x coordinate, or an anchor (with an optional distance) whose x is used. Math expressions only work within the anchor form

distance.description: Distance between the anchor and its mirror image

filter.description: Where to place something: a condition on the points, or an anchor (any object, even nested in a list, turns the whole value into an anchor)

filter_condition.description: true/false for all/no points, a name/tag condition ("-" negates, /regex/flags allowed, "meta.key ~ value" for other fields), or a nested list alternating OR/AND

rotate.description: Rotation of the whole zone around the origin

mirror.description: Mirroring for the points of this zone

columns.description: Named columns, laid out left to right

rows.description: Named rows shared by all columns, laid out bottom to top

anyOf.description: Removes a row inherited from the zone

key.description: Key-level attributes, extended in order global < zone < column < row < column-specific row. Unknown attributes are kept as point metadata, usable in filters and "{{templates}}". A null value (or array element) keeps the inherited value

stagger.description: Vertical shift of the column relative to the previous one (read from the first key of the column)

spread.description: Horizontal distance from the previous column (read from the first key of the column)

splay.description: Column rotation, cumulative for later columns (read from the first key of the column)

origin.description: Splay origin, relative to the first key of the column

orient.description: Rotation before shifting, carried over to later keys of the column

shift.description: Translation, carried over to later keys of the column

rotate.description: Rotation after shifting, carried over to later keys of the column

adjust.description: Independent adjustment of this key only, as an anchor relative to its position

padding.description: Vertical distance to the next key in the column

autobind.description: Default bind distance towards neighboring keys (0 disables)

bind.description: Explicit bind distances for bound outlines, overriding autobind where non-negative

skip.description: Helper point, removed from the output

asym.description: Whether the key exists on the source side, the mirrored side, or both

name.description: Template for the unique point name

tags.description: Tags for filters (a string, a list, or a map whose keys are the tags)

mirror.description: Overrides applied to the mirrored copy of the key

nullable_number.description: A number, a math expression string, or null to keep the inherited (or default) value

nullable_xy.description: An [x, y] pair, or null to keep the inherited value. Arrays are extended element-wise, so shorter arrays keep the inherited elements

nullable_trbl.description: A single number for all sides, a [vertical, horizontal] pair, or a [top, right, bottom, left] quadruplet. Arrays are extended element-wise, so shorter arrays keep the inherited elements

anyOf.description: Shorthand for an existing outline, optionally prefixed with an operation (+ add, - subtract, ~ intersect, ^ stack)

operation.description: How to combine the part with the outline so far

where.description: Points to repeat the part at (defaults to the origin)

asym.description: Which side of mirrored points the where filter applies to

adjust.description: Anchor applied to each where position

bound.description: Extend the shape towards neighboring keys using their bind values

fillet.description: Round the corners of the outline so far

expand.description: Grow (or shrink, if negative) the outline so far. As a string, it can end with ")" (round), ">" (pointy) or "]" (beveled) to set the joints

size.description: Width and height (exposed as sx/sy units to corner, bevel, where and adjust)

bevel.description: Corner bevel, can be combined with corner

radius.description: Radius (exposed as the r unit to where and adjust)

points.description: Polygon corners, each anchored relative to the previous one

name.description: Name of a previously defined outline

origin.description: Anchor in the referenced outline to treat as its origin

segments.description: Connected segments, each starting where the previous one ended. The path is closed with a straight line

points.description: Points to wrap, each anchored relative to the previous one

concavity.description: Hull concavity, lower is more concave

extend.description: Wrap the full key rectangles instead of only their centers

type.description: Segment type. Point counts include the point inherited from the previous segment: line needs 2+, arc 3, s_curve 2, bezier 3 or 4

anyOf.description: Shorthand for an existing case or outline, optionally prefixed with an operation (+ add, - subtract, ~ intersect)

what.description: Whether "name" refers to an outline (extruded) or a previously defined case

name.description: Name of the outline or case

extrude.description: Extrusion height of the outline (outlines only)

rotate.description: Rotation in degrees around the center of the part's bounding box

operation.description: How to combine the part with the case so far

params.description: Custom parameters passed through to the template

outlines.description: Outlines to draw onto the PCB

outline.description: Name of the outline to draw

where.description: Points to place the footprint at (defaults to the origin)

asym.description: Which side of mirrored points the where filter applies to

adjust.description: Anchor applied to each where position

params.description: Footprint parameters. String values are "{{templated}}" with point metadata, and "mirror" holds overrides for mirrored points

allOf.description: Nets without a default are required, unless the footprint is never placed

footprint_param_boolean.description: Boolean footprint parameter, a number (used for its truthiness), or a string (template) that resolves to "true" or 1

footprint_nets_alps.description: Nets without a default, set directly or in mirror overrides (which only apply to mirrored points)

footprint_nets_button.description: Nets without a default, set directly or in mirror overrides (which only apply to mirrored points)
